headline: Argentina Approves $6.3 Billion Mining Project Under RIGI Investment Scheme
summary: The Argentine government approved a $6.3 billion mining project in Catamarca under the RIGI framework, with a plan to process 780 million tonnes of ore over 23 years.
why: Argentina's Large Investments Incentive Regime (RIGI) aims to attract long-term direct foreign investment to major natural resource projects.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: A $6.3 billion long-term mining commitment boosts expected capital inflows and resource export volumes.
